questions.q: £100 up 10%, then down 10%. What is the final price?
questions.a: A) £99. 100 × 1.1 = 110, then 110 × 0.9 = 99. The 10% decrease is of the bigger amount.

questions.q: A wage rises from £400 to £420. Percentage increase?
questions.a: A) 5%. 20 ÷ 400 = 0.05 = 5%. 4.76% divides by the new wage.
A) 7/12. 12 = 2 × 2 × 3 has a factor 3, so 7/12 recurs. 20, 40 and 16 have only 2s and 5s.

questions.q: Roughly how many words in a 300-page book?
questions.a: A) About 90 000. About 300 words a page × 300 pages ≈ 90 000. The others are wrong by powers of 10.

questions.q: 'After a 15% fall, a value is 85.' To find the value before the fall, which method?
questions.a: A) Reverse percentage. 85 is after the change, so divide by 0.85 to find the original: 100.

questions.q: Which is NOT in standard form?
questions.a: A) 10 × 10⁴. 10 × 10⁴ has A = 10, which is too big; it should be 1 × 10⁵.
A) 4.5 × 10⁻². 45 = 4.5 × 10, so 4.5 × 10⁻². 10⁻⁴ moves the wrong way.
